reason: Adds 60 native audit cases to the existing PostgreSQL pytest step, with no additional job, artifact, installation or matrix item. This PR's hosted Windows run 44014536304 measured a median 29.007 seconds (0.48 minutes) for the added file across 20 fresh runners, from their JUnit suite times; 58 cases passed and the two POSIX-only umask cases skipped in each sample. The stress gate correctly rejected the skips, so clean Windows stress uses the 58 applicable cases in a separate dispatch. These are test execution minutes, excluding the existing shared setup; no other shard's steps change. Ordinary PR run 44014517377 skips the edited heavy parity job, whose complete cost remains subject to batch measurement.
